caption:
Paneer Tikka Salad 
high protein | meal prep friendly

Nutrition: 
C: 50 | F: 34 | P: 31
Calories: 580 per portion 
Makes 1 serving

Ingredients

Tikka Marinade - marinate paneer for 30 minutes
120 grams paneer, quantity as per your preference :) 
2 tbsp thick curd
1 tbsp Red chilli powder 
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp Garam masala
1 tsp jeera powder 
Salt to taste
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste 

Salad
Leafy greens - you can use iceburg or romaine OR a mix of both 
1 Cucumber, peel and remove seeds
1 onions, pickled with vinegar and a little monkfruit + chaat masala
Red bell pepper, optional, sliced
Tomato - remove seeds inside part mushy, optional, sliced 

Dressing - combine in the mixer
3 tbsp Greek yogurt
Handful of coriander 
Salt 
Pepper 
Squeeze of lime, optional 
1 tsp Chaat masala
